what_it_changes: Publish a fail-closed commit-status rendezvous for each bounded push-triggered live campaign so watchdog recovery can observe the immutable request commit without enumerating unknown workflow-run IDs.
applicability: idempotent watchdog recovery of bounded genuine-model campaign requests

supporting_evidence.finding: Request commit b37c0aa735fa72f2c609a4159b5b44c19963ee5d remained durably known while the connected GitHub interface could not enumerate its unknown push-triggered workflow run; the prior lease was released rather than duplicate the external request.
